verses.1: And the number of the children of Israel will be like the number of waves in the sea; they will not be counted or recorded. They will be in a place where it is said to them, “You are not my people.” But to them it will be said, “You are children of Elah.”
verses.2: And the children of Israel and the children of Judah were united together. They set one head over them, and they rose up from the earth because of the great day of Yizreel.
verses.3: Say to my people and to your wives, “Mercy.”
verses.4: They fight among yourselves. They fight because she is not my wife, and I am not her husband. They will be destroyed by her actions, and her children will be killed among her children.
verses.5: She was born with a flaw in her face, and when she was born, it was shown to everyone. She was treated as if she were a monster, and she was considered to be like a barren land.
verses.6: And I will not dwell with her children, for they are the children of harlots.
verses.7: For their mother was proud and haughty. She said, “I will go after my lover. I will give him my blood, my tears, and my love.”
verses.8: Therefore, I have followed your path through the waters. I have also marked its course and directions. But you will not be able to find them.
verses.9: And she pursued her lovers, but she couldn’t find them. She searched for them in vain, but she couldn’t find them. Then she said, “I will go back to my former lover, for it is better for me now.”
verses.10: And she did not know that I had given her the lamb, the grain, the oil, and all the money I had. And gold was also given to her as a gift.
verses.11: So I went back and took my fish at that time. I also harvested the crops in that place. I protected them so that their beauty could be preserved.
verses.12: And now, I will unveil her beauty to the eyes of her lover. No one will be able to save her from my hands.
verses.13: And I will celebrate all its festivals, its holidays, and all its celebrations.
verses.14: And I filled her arms and her breasts with those things that my lovers gave me. They were placed in the forest, and their flesh became the flesh of the wild animals.
verses.15: And I was responsible for her during those days when she had to prepare offerings for her lovers. She became sick and suffered greatly. Then she went after her lover, and she forgot about me, oh God!
verses.16: So now, I will pour her out into the sea, and I will speak to her heart.
verses.17: And I gave her her vineyards from there. And I also gave her the steep mountains at the entrance to Tikva. She asked for those places where she had lived in her youth. And now, she stands on the land of Egypt.
verses.18: And on that day, the Lord will call me by my name. No one else will call me by my name anymore.
verses.19: And I took away the names of her husbands from her lips, so that they would no longer be remembered by anyone.
verses.20: And I made a covenant with them on that day, with the life of the field, with the heights of heaven, with the earth’s surface, with rocks, with ruins, and from war, let there be no destruction from the earth.
verses.21: And I will keep you forever with me. I will keep you in righteousness and justice, in kindness and mercy.
verses.22: And I will take you for my wife, and you shall know Jehovah.
verses.23: And on that day, “I will answer,” says the LORD. I will answer the heavens, and they will answer the earth.
verses.24: And the earth will answer for the sower and for the seed. They will answer for Yizreel.
verses.25: And her seed came to me in the land. I showed mercy toward her, but not mercy toward others. I said to my people, “You are my people; she is not.” And he will say, “Lord!”
